JPMorgan CEO Warns of Small Business Succession Crisis

JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon has warned that the American Dream is slipping away, citing a significant risk to millions of small businesses. A new report from the bank highlights a succession crisis, with a large number of small business owners retiring without clear plans for transferring their companies. This lack of planning threatens the continuity of businesses and jobs across the nation. JPMorgan Chase is advocating for national planning to address this issue.
